Use case: illustration-story

Follow the approved thumbnail style already visually inspected: near-black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm off-white, energetic hand-painted ink and dry-brush textures, very bold crisp Japanese lettering, few elements, graphic rather than photographic.

Editorial content is ONLY from the supplied fixed article: Kobe won the second game 90–87 against Nagasaki on November 1; the two-game series ended one win each. Do not add any other fact, player statistic, ranking, or game date. Publication date is 2026.11.03.

Subject: one REAL player, Levi Randolph (リーヴァイ・ランドルフ), randomly selected from names in the article. His name must NOT appear on the image. Use the official Nagasaki Velca portrait visually inspected in this conversation ONLY as facial appearance guidance, never as a pasted photograph:

https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026110115/files/user/roster/2488/2026-27/51000670_01.jpg

No voluminous afro. Preserve these facial traits in a confident hand-drawn illustration. Dark plain sleeveless basketball uniform with subtle cool navy highlights; no lettering, logos, numbers, or sponsor marks. Plain dark arm sleeve on his left forearm is optional. Any arm tattoo texture should remain abstract ink detail.

Composition: place the player on the LEFT 40–43 percent, a dynamic three-quarter-view forward dribbling drive, torso leaning, one hand naturally guiding an orange basketball near hip level. Show his face clearly and both arms with plausible anatomy; keep the entire ball and hands inside the frame. Use an original generic basketball movement, NOT a recreation of either actual match and NOT a winning-shot, buzzer-beater, scoring, or celebration scene. No other people or anonymous background players. No hoop needed. Lime brush sweeps and restrained ink scratches imply movement behind the player. Keep right side as clean typographic negative space.

small header: "バスケまとめ"
small publication date: "2026.11.03"
largest headline in bold warm off-white or lime: "神戸が雪辱"

Render ALL Japanese text verbatim with correct glyphs, punctuation, digits and parentheses. No other text. No individual player's name, points, appearance or contribution claim. The 90 and 87 are TEAM scores only.

Constraints: retain generous outer safe margins of at least 5 percent. No clipped lettering, hands, face or ball. No team or league logos, sponsor text, trademarks, official photograph fragments or realistic photo treatment. No medals, trophy, championship motifs or extra statistics. This must read as a bold ink-and-brush illustration with a clearly real player's recognizable facial traits. Keep the whole image visually coherent and legible at thumbnail size.

Edit the first image: this is the existing finished black-and-lime Japanese basketball thumbnail. The second image is Levi Randolph's official portrait for APPEARANCE REFERENCE ONLY; never paste or reproduce that photograph in the thumbnail.

Keep the lively dribbling pose and obvious brush-and-ink illustrative rendering. Preserve brown skin.

Keep both hands anatomically plausible with five fingers.
Preserve the near-black #151A18 / lime #CCF43B / warm-white palette, dry brush energy, navy blank uniform, graphic style, orange ball and single-player composition. Do not add any people, logos, uniforms with lettering, jersey numbers or sponsor marks. Do not make this photographic.
